note: Daniel Nowak's STAR stories (fictional persona for the evals).

stories.title: Cut the dashboard's first load from 6.1 s to 1.8 s
stories.situation: At ElevenLabs the customer dashboard took 6.1 seconds to show anything on a typical laptop, and support tickets about it grew every week.
stories.task: I owned the frontend of the dashboard and was asked to make the first load fast without a rewrite.
stories.action: I measured with Lighthouse and the browser profiler, split the bundle by route, moved the usage charts behind a lazy boundary, and rendered the account summary on the server with Next.js.
stories.result: First load dropped from 6.1 s to 1.8 s, the bundle shrank by 58%, and the slow-dashboard tickets stopped within a month.
stories.short: Cut a React dashboard's first load from 6.1 s to 1.8 s by route splitting, lazy charts and server rendering.

stories.title: Got four teams onto one component library
stories.situation: Four product teams at ElevenLabs each kept their own buttons, modals and form fields, and the same bug was fixed four times.
stories.task: I proposed a shared library and had to win over teams that were happy with their own components.
stories.action: I built the first ten components in Storybook with the most-used variants, paired with one engineer from each team to migrate a real screen, and ran a short weekly review where teams could request changes.
stories.result: Within two quarters all four teams used the library for new screens and duplicated UI bugs dropped to near zero.
stories.short: Led four product teams onto one Storybook component library by pairing on real migrations.

stories.title: Settled a disagreement about pagination in the booking API
stories.situation: At Blueport Labs a backend colleague and I disagreed on cursor versus offset pagination for the booking API, and the frontend work was blocked.
stories.task: I needed an answer both of us could live with before the sprint ended.
stories.action: I wrote both versions against a copy of production data, measured them on the slowest query, and brought the numbers to a short meeting instead of arguments.
stories.result: Cursor pagination was four times faster on large accounts; my colleague agreed, and we shipped it in the same sprint.
stories.short: Ended a pagination dispute by benchmarking both options on real data; cursor won and shipped that sprint.

about.title: About me (short)
about.text: Senior frontend-leaning full-stack engineer in Kraków with six years of React and TypeScript, currently building the customer dashboard at ElevenLabs. I like making slow things fast and shared code that several teams can rely on.
